name: chatwoot
description: Reads and writes the full account-scoped Chatwoot Application API support-desk surface: conversations, contacts, inboxes, agents, agent bots, teams, labels, conversation-scoped messages, canned responses, custom attribute definitions, custom filters, webhooks, integration hooks, automation rules, help-center portals, inbox membership, and account settings.

risk.read: external Chatwoot Application API read of conversation, contact, agent, and account-configuration data (account-scoped)
risk.write: external mutation of Chatwoot contacts, conversations, messages, labels, agents, agent bots, teams, automation rules, webhooks, and other account-scoped configuration; agent-visible and customer-visible side effects, including destructive deletes behind typed confirmation
